headline: King's first win ends a run of eight defeats
dek: King had lost all eight of their matches before they went to North Greenville. They come back with their first win of the season, and a record that now reads one win and eight defeats.
displaced_by: results night: King win at North Greenville for the first time this season after eight defeats
